name: windows
title: Windows
description: Every window: stable ID, title, active, modal, size.

name: snapshot
title: Snapshot
description: The control tree as an outline: role, name, [stable ID], states, value, the actions each node takes and what its press opens (needs_user: it opens a dialog the user answers; instead= names a tool that does the same without one). A virtualised list says how many rows it does not show. Narrow it with root and filter; actions false leaves the actions out.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

name: find
title: Find
description: Nodes by role, name (any case, part of it) and state, each with its [stable ID] and parent; cheaper than a snapshot when you know what you look for.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

name: act
title: Act
description: A semantic action on a node (press, select, expand, collapse, focus, set_value, increment, decrement, show_menu, close), scroll_into_view, or invoke_command on a command's stable ID. A row a virtualised list does not show is reached by its ID. A dialog you opened may be closed (close on the dialog, as Cancel), never submitted. Waits for idle and replies with what changed; terse gives counts.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: reset
title: Reset
description: Puts the interface back in order: closes the dialogs you opened (as Cancel), popups and menus, tooltips and drags, releases pointer capture and a hold, and stops content that froze; replies with what it reset and what it left (a dialog the user opened).

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

name: pointer
title: Pointer
description: Pointer input through the program's own input path: move, hover, click, double_click, right_click, down, up, drag, wheel; at a target (offset inside it, default its centre) or a window position.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: keyboard
title: Keyboard
description: Key chords ("Ctrl+S") and sequences, committed text, and composition, to the focused control or to a target focused first.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: text
title: Text
description: A node's whole text: a text control's value, selection and lines (with select, sets the selection, UTF-8 byte offsets); any other node's full name, value and description, such as a label cut in the outline.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: wait
title: Wait
description: Waits until the next frame, idle, a time (ms), a condition on a node (state, value, exists) or a user step done.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: capture
title: Capture
description: A window or control as a PNG, drawn fresh from the current state; a window's open popup windows (menus, drop-downs) and its tooltip window are composited over it unless popups is false. Password fields are painted out.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: inspect
title: Inspect
description: Beyond accessibility, sections chosen with what: state, layout, paint, metrics, dispatcher, interaction, session, schema, clipboard, summary, layout_reasons, resources, events. With a target, state, layout and schema by default; without, metrics, dispatcher and interaction.

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

name: batch
title: Batch
description: Several steps in one call with one combined reply: each step is {"tool": name, ...that tool's arguments} or an expect guard {"expect": "node"|"visual", target, state, value, exists, drawn}; the batch stops at the first failure or unmet expectation. terse gives each act's changes as counts.

items.description: a tool step {tool, ...that tool's arguments} or an expect step {expect, window, target, within, state, value, exists, drawn}

window.description: a window's stable ID or title; default the active window

target.description: a node's stable ID, or #r<n> for a runtime ID

within.description: an ancestor's stable ID, when the target's ID repeats

state.description: a state the node has, or -state for one it lacks

drawn.description: visual: whether the state is drawn

name: control
title: Control
description: direct_begin and direct_end hold the interface with a take-back popup (launched --model-directed); suspend_input and resume_input in builds with the test controls; status.
